findings.body: The focus preservation logic uses previousTaskIdRef in a useEffect to compare against currentTaskId, which safely prevents focus stealing during React 18 StrictMode double-invokes, rather than relying on a brittle isInitialMount boolean.
findings.title: StrictMode Safety Verified

findings.body: When the task sequence is reset, previousTaskIdRef.current is updated synchronously with the state update to freshTasks[0].id. This ensures the useEffect for focus restoration returns early and does not steal focus away from the header, which is correctly focused via headerRef.current?.focus().
findings.title: Reset Header Focus Preserved
